source: disclosures-clerk.house.gov (House Clerk financial disclosure index + PTR PDFs), text extracted with pypdf
caveats: STOCK Act allows up to 45 days between trade and disclosure: use filed_date as available_from, never transaction_date.
Amounts are ranges; amount_mid is an approximation, not a size.
Asset type code [ST] is a stock, [GS] a government security — the bracketed code is NOT a ticker; ticker_guess comes from the (PAREN) in the description.
Partial sample only (--max-ptr); the index covers every filing in the years indexed.
House only. Senate eFD needs an interactive agreement flow and is not covered.
